p=Path('ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c')
text=p.read_text()
text=text.replace('  size_t uncompressedOffset = rand() % (size + 1);\n\n  FUZZ_dataProducer_t *uncompressedProducer =\n      FUZZ_dataProducer_create(uncompressedData, size);\n  size_t uncompressedSize =\n      FUZZ_dataProducer_remainingBytes(uncompressedProducer);\n', '  size_t uncompressedOffset = rand() % (size + 1);\n\n  FUZZ_ASSERT(uncompressedData || size == 0);\n  FUZZ_dataProducer_t *uncompressedProducer =\n      FUZZ_dataProducer_create(uncompressedData, size);\n  size_t uncompressedSize =\n      FUZZ_dataProducer_remainingBytes(uncompressedProducer);\n')
p.write_text(text)
PY
